WITH as_at AS ( SELECT DATE('${asAtDate}') AS d, DATE('${asAtDate}') = CURDATE() AS is_today ), par_band AS ( SELECT 1 AS id, 'Normal' AS name, 0 AS min_dpd, 30 AS max_dpd UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Watch', 31, 90 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Substandard', 91, 180 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Doubtful', 181, 365 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Loss', 366, NULL ), scope AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ml.id AS loan_id, ml.grace_on_arrears_ageing AS grace, COALESCE(prd.arrears_based_on_original_schedule, 0) = 1 AS original_schedule FROM m_office mo JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') AND ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') JOIN m_client mc ON mc.office_id = ounder.id JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.client_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan_recalculation_details prd ON prd.product_id = ml.product_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND ( (p.is_today AND ml.loan_status_id = 300) OR (NOT p.is_today AND ml.loan_status_id IN (300, 600, 601, 602, 700) AND ml.disbursedon_date <= p.d AND (ml.loan_status_id NOT IN (600, 602) OR ml.closedon_date IS NULL OR ml.closedon_date > p.d) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_loan_transaction wo WHERE wo.loan_id = ml.id AND wo.transaction_type_enum IN (6, 32) AND wo.transaction_date <= p.d AND (wo.is_reversed = 0 OR COALESCE((SELECT MIN(un.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction un WHERE un.loan_id = ml.id AND un.original_transaction_id = wo.id AND un.transaction_type_enum = 33), DATE(wo.last_modified_on_utc)) > p.d))) ) ), live AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.loan_id, t.transaction_type_enum AS type, t.transaction_date AS txn_date, t.amount, COALESCE(t.principal_portion_derived, 0) AS principal_portion, COALESCE(t.interest_portion_derived, 0) AS interest_portion FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_transaction t ON t.loan_id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE NOT p.is_today AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_type_enum NOT IN (1, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 26, 27) AND t.transaction_date <= p.d ), mapped AS ( SELECT rs.id AS sid, rs.loan_id, rs.duedate, live.type, live.txn_date, IF(live.type = 18, -1, 1) AS sign, COALESCE(mp.principal_portion_derived, 0) AS p, COALESCE(mp.interest_portion_derived, 0) AS i, COALESCE(mp.fee_charges_portion_derived, 0) AS f, COALESCE(mp.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping mp ON mp.loan_transaction_id = live.id JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.id = mp.loan_repayment_schedule_id ), alloc AS ( SELECT sid, SUM(sign * p) AS p, SUM(sign * i) AS i, SUM(sign * f) AS f, SUM(sign * pen) AS pen, SUM(IF(type = 4, 0, sign * p)) AS p_paid, SUM(IF(type = 4, 0, sign * i)) AS i_paid, SUM(IF(type <> 4 AND txn_date < duedate, sign * (p + i + f), 0)) AS in_advance FROM mapped GROUP BY sid ), charge_waived AS ( SELECT rs.id AS sid, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 0, pb.amount, 0)) AS f, SUM(IF(c.is_penalty = 1, pb.amount, 0)) AS pen FROM live JOIN m_loan_charge_paid_by pb ON pb.loan_transaction_id = live.id JOIN m_loan_charge c ON c.id = pb.loan_charge_id AND c.is_active = 1 JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = c.loan_id AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date > rs.fromdate AND c.due_for_collection_as_of_date <= rs.duedate WHERE live.type = 9 GROUP BY rs.id ), loan_event AS ( SELECT loan_id, SUM(IF(type = 31, amount, 0)) AS partial_writeoff, MAX(type = 34) AS interest_cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN type IN (2, 23, 28) THEN principal_portion WHEN type = 18 THEN -principal_portion ELSE 0 END) AS principal_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN type IN (2, 23, 28) THEN interest_portion WHEN type = 18 THEN -interest_portion ELSE 0 END) AS interest_paid FROM live WHERE type IN (2, 18, 23, 28, 31, 34) GROUP BY loan_id ), writeoff_fill AS ( SELECT rs.id AS sid, GREATEST(le.partial_writeoff - COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(rs.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.loan_id ORDER BY rs.duedate, rs.installment ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0), 0) AS budget, COALESCE(rs.principal_writtenoff_derived, 0) AS wp, COALESCE(rs.interest_writtenoff_derived, 0) AS wi, COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) AS wf, COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived, 0) AS wpen FROM scope s JOIN loan_event le ON le.loan_id = s.loan_id AND le.partial_writeoff > 0 JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = s.loan_id ), writeoff_split AS ( SELECT sid, LEAST(wp, budget) AS p, LEAST(wi, GREATEST(budget - wp, 0)) AS i, LEAST(wf, GREATEST(budget - wp - wi, 0)) AS f, LEAST(wpen, GREATEST(budget - wp - wi - wf, 0)) AS pen FROM writeoff_fill ), instalment AS ( SELECT rs.loan_id, s.original_schedule, rs.duedate, rs.duedate < DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL COALESCE(s.grace, 0) DAY) AS is_overdue, COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.p, 0) - COALESCE(wf.p, 0) AS principal_due, COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.i, 0) - COALESCE(wf.i, 0) - IF(COALESCE(le.interest_cancelled, 0) = 1, COALESCE(rs.interest_cancelled_derived, 0), 0) AS interest_due, COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.f, 0) - COALESCE(w.f, 0) - COALESCE(wf.f, 0) AS fee_due, COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0) - COALESCE(a.pen, 0) - COALESCE(w.pen, 0) - COALESCE(wf.pen, 0) AS penalty_due, IF(rs.duedate >= p.d, COALESCE(a.in_advance, 0), 0) AS in_advance, COALESCE(a.p_paid, 0) AS principal_paid, COALESCE(a.i_paid, 0) AS interest_paid, COALESCE(a.p, 0) - COALESCE(a.p_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wf.p, 0) AS principal_settled_unpaid, COALESCE(a.i, 0) - COALESCE(a.i_paid, 0) AS interest_waived, COALESCE(a.f, 0) + COALESCE(w.f, 0) + COALESCE(wf.f, 0) AS fee_settled, COALESCE(a.pen, 0) + COALESCE(w.pen, 0) + COALESCE(wf.pen, 0) AS penalty_settled FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p LEFT JOIN alloc a ON a.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN charge_waived w ON w.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN writeoff_split wf ON wf.sid = rs.id LEFT JOIN loan_event le ON le.loan_id = rs.loan_id WHERE NOT p.is_today ), instalment_due AS ( SELECT i.*, is_overdue AND ROUND(principal_due + interest_due + fee_due + penalty_due, 2) > 0 AS in_arrears FROM instalment i ), loan_aging AS ( SELECT loan_id, MAX(original_schedule) AS original_schedule, SUM(principal_paid + principal_settled_unpaid) AS principal_cover, SUM(interest_paid + interest_waived) AS interest_cover, SUM(fee_settled) AS fee_cover, SUM(penalty_settled) AS penalty_cover, SUM(IF(in_arrears, principal_due, 0)) AS principal_overdue, SUM(IF(in_arrears, interest_due, 0)) AS interest_overdue, SUM(IF(in_arrears, principal_due + interest_due + fee_due + penalty_due, 0)) AS total_overdue, MIN(IF(in_arrears, duedate, NULL)) AS overdue_since, SUM(in_advance) AS in_advance FROM instalment_due GROUP BY loan_id ), original_schedule_fill AS ( SELECT h.loan_id, h.duedate, COALESCE(h.principal_amount, 0) AS principal_due, COALESCE(h.interest_amount, 0) AS interest_due, COALESCE(h.fee_charges_amount, 0) AS fee_due, COALESCE(h.penalty_charges_amount, 0) AS penalty_due, lp.principal_cover - SUM(COALESCE(h.principal_amount, 0)) OVER w + COALESCE(h.principal_amount, 0) AS principal_left, lp.interest_cover - SUM(COALESCE(h.interest_amount, 0)) OVER w + COALESCE(h.interest_amount, 0) AS interest_left, lp.fee_cover - SUM(COALESCE(h.fee_charges_amount, 0)) OVER w + COALESCE(h.fee_charges_amount, 0) AS fee_left, lp.penalty_cover - SUM(COALESCE(h.penalty_charges_amount, 0)) OVER w + COALESCE(h.penalty_charges_amount, 0) AS penalty_left FROM loan_aging lp JOIN scope s ON s.loan_id = lp.loan_id JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule_history h ON h.loan_id = lp.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE lp.original_schedule = 1 AND lp.overdue_since IS NOT NULL AND h.version = (SELECT MAX(hv.version) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule_history hv WHERE hv.loan_id = h.loan_id) AND h.duedate < DATE_SUB(p.d, INTERVAL COALESCE(s.grace, 0) DAY) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY h.loan_id ORDER BY h.duedate, h.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) ), original_schedule_due AS ( SELECT loan_id, duedate, principal_due - LEAST(principal_due, GREATEST(principal_left, 0)) AS principal_short, interest_due - LEAST(interest_due, GREATEST(interest_left, 0)) AS interest_short, principal_due > GREATEST(principal_left, 0) OR interest_due > GREATEST(interest_left, 0) OR fee_due > GREATEST(fee_left, 0) OR penalty_due > GREATEST(penalty_left, 0) AS incomplete FROM original_schedule_fill ), original_schedule_aging AS ( SELECT loan_id, SUM(IF(incomplete, principal_short, 0)) AS principal_overdue, SUM(IF(incomplete, interest_short, 0)) AS interest_overdue, MIN(IF(incomplete AND principal_short > 0, duedate, NULL)) AS overdue_since FROM original_schedule_due GROUP BY loan_id HAVING SUM(IF(incomplete, principal_short, 0)) > 0 ), as_at_aging AS ( SELECT loan_id, principal_overdue, interest_overdue, overdue_since FROM loan_aging WHERE original_schedule = 0 AND total_overdue > in_advance UNION ALL SELECT loan_id, principal_overdue, interest_overdue, overdue_since FROM original_schedule_aging ), aging AS ( SELECT laa.loan_id, ml.principal_disbursed_derived AS original_principal, ml.interest_charged_derived AS original_interest, ml.principal_repaid_derived AS principal_paid, ml.interest_repaid_derived AS interest_paid, laa.principal_overdue_derived AS principal_overdue, laa.interest_overdue_derived AS interest_overdue, DATEDIFF(p.d, laa.overdue_since_date_derived) AS dpd FROM scope s JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = s.loan_id JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = s.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE p.is_today UNION ALL SELECT a.loan_id, ml.principal_disbursed_derived - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(dd.principal) FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail dd WHERE dd.loan_id = a.loan_id AND dd.disbursedon_date > p.d), 0), ml.interest_charged_derived, COALESCE(le.principal_paid, 0), COALESCE(le.interest_paid, 0), a.principal_overdue, a.interest_overdue, DATEDIFF(p.d, a.overdue_since) FROM as_at_aging a JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = a.loan_id LEFT JOIN loan_event le ON le.loan_id = a.loan_id CROSS JOIN as_at p WHERE a.overdue_since IS NOT NULL ) SELECT concat(repeat("..", ((LENGTH(ounder.`hierarchy`) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ounder.`hierarchy`, '.', '')) - 1))), ounder.`name`) as "Office/Branch", ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code) as Currency, mc.account_no as "Client Account No.", mc.display_name AS "Client Name", ml.account_no AS "Account Number", ml.principal_amount AS "Loan Amount", ag.original_principal AS "Original Principal", ag.original_interest AS "Original Interest", ag.principal_paid AS "Principal Paid", ag.interest_paid AS "Interest Paid", ag.principal_overdue AS "Principal Overdue", ag.interest_overdue AS "Interest Overdue", ag.dpd as "Days in Arrears",
IF(ag.dpd<7, '<1', IF(ag.dpd<8, ' 1', IF(ag.dpd<15, '2', IF(ag.dpd<22, ' 3', IF(ag.dpd<29, ' 4', IF(ag.dpd<36, ' 5', IF(ag.dpd<43, ' 6', IF(ag.dpd<50, ' 7', IF(ag.dpd<57, ' 8', IF(ag.dpd<64, ' 9', IF(ag.dpd<71, '10', IF(ag.dpd<78, '11', IF(ag.dpd<85, '12', '12+')))))))))))) )AS "Weeks In Arrears Band",
IF(ag.dpd<31, '0 - 30', IF(ag.dpd<61, '30 - 60', IF(ag.dpd<91, '60 - 90', IF(ag.dpd<181, '90 - 180', IF(ag.dpd<361, '180 - 360', '> 360'))))) AS "Days in Arrears Band", par.name AS "PAR Category"
FROM aging ag JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = ag.loan_id JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.id = mc.office_id LEFT JOIN m_currency cur ON cur.code = ml.currency_code LEFT JOIN par_band par ON ag.dpd >= par.min_dpd AND (par.max_dpd IS NULL OR ag.dpd <= par.max_dpd) WHERE (${parCategory} = -1 OR par.id = ${parCategory}) ORDER BY ounder.hierarchy, ifnull(cur.display_symbol, ml.currency_code), ml.account_no
